normalization_plan.reason: Amount is a transient parameter fully consumed by the transfer entry point; it carries no independent semantic identity.
Source address parameter only exists to drive the _transfer control flow branches.
Destination address parameter only exists to drive pair/cooldown branching inside _transfer.
Token amount parameter is fully absorbed by the reflection accounting performed in _transferStandard.
Swap amount parameter has no meaning outside the router swap call it feeds.
Owner-supplied limit is immediately validated and stored, so it merges into the setter.
Owner-supplied tax value is immediately validated and stored, so it merges into the setter.
Blacklist array is only iterated inside getBots and has no standalone semantics.
Local rate value is derived by _getRate and should be represented by that core function.
